mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 5% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% in 3 months and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening economy, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and PAYEMS both increase in the same month
failure_condition: If HOUST and PAYEMS both increase in the same month and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% in 3 months and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, which can lead to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in the same month
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in the same month and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals a growing economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.
